info.description: Cyber Threat Intelligence Platform read API. M1 exposes anonymous read access to public TLP:CLEAR intelligence with cursor pagination; authentication, RBAC and write endpoints arrive in M2. All errors share a single ErrorResponse shape with a log-correlated traceId (see docs/spec/09-api.md §9.4).
info.title: CTIP API

get.description: Returns every key issued for the caller's tenant, including revoked ones. The key material itself is never returned. 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 apikey:create。

200.description: API keys of the caller's tenant

post.description: Issues a key for the caller's tenant. The full key is returned exactly once and only its SHA-256 hash is stored; scopes may not exceed the creator's own permissions. 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 apikey:create。

201.description: Key created; full key returned once

delete.description: Revocation is irreversible. Keys belonging to another tenant are reported as not found rather than forbidden. 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 apikey:revoke。

404.description: Unknown key or another tenant's key (NOT_FOUND)

post.description: Returns an access token (15 minutes by default) and a single-use refresh token. Ten consecutive failures lock the account for fifteen minutes. 認證:匿名(本端點用於取得憑證)。
post.summary: Log in with email and password

post.description: Revokes every refresh token in the presented token's family. Access tokens are short-lived and are not blacklisted. 認證:以請求主體中的 refresh token 認證,不需 Authorization 標頭。
Exchanges a refresh token for a new pair. The presented token is consumed; replaying an already-used token revokes the whole token family. 認證:以請求主體中的 refresh token 認證,不需 Authorization 標頭。

401.description: Unknown, revoked, expired or reused token (UNAUTHENTICATED)

post.description: Creates a user together with a new INDIVIDUAL tenant and enrols the user as its TENANT_ADMIN, then returns a session. Passwords are stored as BCrypt hashes only. 認證:匿名(本端點用於取得憑證)。

get.description: Returns UP when the API is able to serve requests. Dependency health (database, etc.) is exposed separately at /actuator/health. 認證:匿名。

Lists visible indicators ordered by (lastSeen DESC, id DESC). Filters: type, severity, status, tlp, tags (repeat the parameter; all must match), sourceId, confidenceMin/Max, scoreMin/Max, lastSeenFrom/To (ISO-8601); EXPIRED entries are excluded unless includeExpired=true. limit above the plan maximum is clamped, not rejected. offset mode is for page-number UIs only and is capped at 10000. 認證:匿名(僅 public TLP:CLEAR)。

post.description: Runs the full ingestion pipeline (validation, normalisation, deduplication, merge) — no stage is bypassed. The owning tenant is always the submitter's; it cannot be chosen. TLP defaults to AMBER; CLEAR/GREEN additionally require ioc:publish and transfer ownership to the public tenant. Returns 201 for a new IOC, 200 when merged into an existing one. 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 ioc:submit。

400.description: Rejected by the pipeline, e.g. private IP (INVALID_IOC_FORMAT)

403.description: Missing ioc:submit / ioc:publish, or the plan disables manual submission (FORBIDDEN / PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED)

post.description: Accepts text/csv or a STIX 2.1 bundle (application/json). Processed asynchronously: returns 202 with an importJobId, poll GET /iocs/import/{jobId} for progress. Imported IOCs are always private to the tenant (TLP:AMBER). Rows beyond the plan's daily quota are recorded individually as QUOTA_EXCEEDED rather than failing the whole file. 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 ioc:import。

413.description: File exceeds the plan's row limit (PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE)

get.description: Jobs of another tenant are reported as not found rather than forbidden. 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 ioc:import。

404.description: Unknown job or another tenant's job (NOT_FOUND)

post.description: Verifies up to the plan limit of values in one call (anonymous: 20). Values are cleaned and normalized before identity matching; unparsable or invisible values are reported as found=false, never as errors. Bloom-filter clients must confirm hits here (11 §11.6). 認證:匿名。

Substring search over the canonical (normalized) value with the same filters and cursor pagination as the list endpoint (type, severity, status, tlp, tags, sourceId, confidence/score ranges, lastSeen range). M1 backs this with PostgreSQL (pg_trgm / GIN indexes); M2 swaps in Elasticsearch behind the same contract. Set `fuzzy: true` for typosquatting detection (Levenshtein matching) — it is an Elasticsearch-only capability and is ignored when the request is served by PostgreSQL. Every response carries `X-Search-Backend: elasticsearch|postgres` so callers can tell which engine answered; a degraded search still returns 200. 認證:匿名。

X-Search-Backend.description: Which engine served this query: elasticsearch or postgres (postgres means the Elasticsearch path was unavailable and the request was degraded — fuzzy matching does not apply)

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST (blank query, unknown enum value, bad cursor)

get.description: Returns a single indicator by id. Cross-tenant or invisible resources are always 404 (existence is never disclosed). 認證:匿名。

post.description: Marks the MANUAL source record of the IOC as FALSE_POSITIVE and re-runs the merge policy — the resulting status is decided by that policy, never by the caller. Only the caller tenant's own IOCs are accepted; reports against public intelligence go through the platform appeal process. 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 ioc:report-fp。

403.description: The IOC belongs to the public intelligence pool (FORBIDDEN)

get.description: Per-source observations for one indicator. Redistribution policy is enforced: for non-owner viewers only PUBLIC_REDISTRIBUTABLE and ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRED records are returned (DERIVED_ONLY and INTERNAL_ONLY are masked). 認證:匿名。

200.description: Visible source records (may be empty when policy masks them)

get.description: All configured threat sources with their TLP defaults, redistribution policy snapshot basis and health status. 認證:匿名。
A single source by id. 認證:匿名。
Sync health for one source: status transitions (ACTIVE/DEGRADED/FAILED/DISABLED), consecutive failures, timestamps and masked last error. 認證:匿名。
Indicator counts, enablement, health status and last success time per threat source. 認證:匿名。

Total visible ACTIVE indicators, distribution by type and the last-7-day trend (daily counts by lastSeen, zero-filled). Scoped by the caller's visibility — anonymous callers see public TLP:CLEAR data only. 認證:匿名。

Exports visible, redistributable indicators plus the referenced TLP 2.0 marking-definitions as one STIX 2.1 bundle. Object count is capped by plan (PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED above the cap). 認證:stix:export——匿名不可用;M1 尚無登入流程,一律回 403,Phase 13 起依 RBAC 判定。

Returns a stored STIX 2.1 object by its STIX id: indicator projections (indicator--{uuid}) after visibility and redistribution filtering, and the five fixed TLP 2.0 marking-definitions served from constants. 認證:匿名。

parameters.description: STIX id, e.g. indicator--{uuid} or marking-definition--{uuid}
parameters.name: stixId

200.description: The STIX object (verbatim stored JSON for indicators)

get.description: Returns the plan in effect for the caller's tenant together with all quota values. A tenant without an active subscription is on FREE (invariant B4). 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 subscription:read。
Current consumption against the plan's quotas. A null limit means unlimited; 0 means the capability is disabled on this plan. 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 subscription:read。

Streams the newest full snapshot for the scope as binary, encoded with the compression named in the manifest. Verify X-Bloom-Checksum against the SHA-256 of the decompressed array before use, and store X-Bloom-Dataset-Version / X-Bloom-Version as your local version — the manifest's bloomVersion is the newest version reachable via delta, not the version of this artifact. Download authorization follows the plan (public_bloom_enabled / tenant_bloom_capacity) and consumes the sync interval (429 when called again too soon). 認證:需要 sync:bloom(ANONYMOUS 角色亦持有);scope=TENANT 另需方案含 tenant Bloom。

X-Bloom-Bit-Size.description: bitSize (m); the array is ceil(m/8) bytes

X-Bloom-Checksum.description: SHA-256 of the uncompressed bit array

X-Bloom-Version.description: bloomVersion of this artifact (0 for a full snapshot)

403.description: PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED — the plan does not include this Bloom layer

404.description: NOT_FOUND — no snapshot has been generated yet

get.description: Returns every bit index added between `base` and the newest version of the current dataset, encoded as ascending-deduplicated LEB128 varint deltas in base64url without padding. Apply them, then verify `resultingChecksum`; on mismatch discard and download a full snapshot. 409 SNAPSHOT_REQUIRED when the chain is too long, when no snapshot exists yet, or when `base` is not part of the current dataset. 認證:需要 sync:delta(匿名不持有)。

200.description: Bits added between base and target

403.description: Missing sync:delta permission (FORBIDDEN) or plan without this Bloom layer

example.message: Delta chain too long, download full snapshot

409.description: SNAPSHOT_REQUIRED — download a full snapshot instead

get.summary: Get the delta since a base version

get.description: Metadata for both Bloom layers plus the mandatory coverage disclosure. `checksum` is the SHA-256 the local bit array must have once fully synced, and `sizeBytes` is the uncompressed array length; `compression` is the transport encoding used by GET /sync/bloom. A layer is omitted when there is nothing to sync there (no snapshot yet, or the plan has no tenant Bloom). This endpoint is not rate-limited by min_sync_interval_seconds so clients can poll it cheaply. 認證:需要 sync:bloom(ANONYMOUS 角色亦持有)。

200.description: Manifest for the layers the caller may sync

get.description: Lists visible threats ordered by (lastSeen DESC, id DESC). Filters: type, status, severity, tlp, name (case-insensitive substring), tags and aliases (repeat the parameter; all must match). RETIRED threats are excluded unless includeRetired=true or status is given explicitly. limit above the plan maximum is clamped, not rejected. 認證:匿名(僅 public TLP:CLEAR)。

post.description: The owning tenant is always the caller's; it cannot be chosen. TLP defaults to AMBER (private); CLEAR/GREEN additionally require ioc:publish and transfer ownership to the public tenant (same rule as POST /iocs); RED is rejected. The TLP is tightened automatically when stricter IOCs are linked (invariant H6) and is never widened — linking a private IOC to a public threat therefore takes that threat out of public visibility. (ownerTenantId, type, name) must be unique within the tenant (H1). 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 threat:manage。

409.description: A threat with the same (type, name) already exists in this tenant (CONFLICT)

get.description: Returns a single threat by id. Cross-tenant or invisible resources are always 404 (existence is never disclosed). indicatorCount is the total number of links, not the number visible to the caller. 認證:匿名。

post.description: externalId or url must be present (invariant H3); (sourceName, externalId) is unique within the threat (H4, enforced with COALESCE so a null externalId still collides). 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 threat:manage。

201.description: Reference added; returns the updated threat

post.summary: Add an external reference to a threat

get.description: Returns the linked indicators ordered by addedAt. Each indicator is filtered by the same TLP and redistribution rules as GET /iocs — a link never exposes an IOC the caller could not read directly, so this list can be shorter than indicatorCount. 認證:匿名。
get.summary: List the IOCs linked to a threat

delete.description: Removes the link and its STIX relationship projection. The threat's TLP is not widened — tightening is one-way. Returns 404 when the link does not exist. 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 threat:manage。

404.description: Threat or link missing / not visible (NOT_FOUND)

delete.summary: Unlink an IOC from a threat

put.description: Idempotent: linking an already linked IOC only updates its role. The link stores the indicator id only (invariant H5). Linking a stricter IOC tightens the threat's TLP (H6). Both the threat and the IOC must belong to — or be visible to — the caller's tenant; otherwise 404. 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 threat:manage。

404.description: Threat or IOC missing / not visible (NOT_FOUND)

put.summary: Link an IOC to a threat (or change its role)

put.description: ACTIVE / DORMANT / RETIRED. RETIRED is terminal: a retired threat accepts no further changes (create a new threat instead). Setting the status it already has returns 409 rather than silently succeeding. 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 threat:manage。

409.description: Already retired, or already in that status (CONFLICT)

get.description: Returns the API contract version (v1) and the build version of the running application (dev when running from sources). 認證:匿名。
